title: I'm honestly amazed at how far Orbital Empires has come through the combination of player feedback and Opus 5.5
author: everybodytrustslorne
selftext:
Hello friends! I've been working on Orbital Empires for about half a year now. I played the first few versions with my friends, making major iterations between each round and loading player feedback right into my workflows to find the best UX, mechanic, or balance solution. Honestly, I was having as much fun making the game as I was playing it with my friends. 

I opened playtesting up to the public about a month ago, and the influx of feedback and testing has allowed me to build a pipeline with Opus 5.5 that rapidly identifies, patches, and deploys fixes and balance updates.  I've also been able to generate an incredible new suite of visual updates by training Claude design on public nasa images of planets. 

Could I get your feedback too? 

Orbital Empire is a hybrid 4x Strategy multiplayer game that simulates the vastness of the solar system with real time. Games unfold over weeks or days, with the alliances and betrayals feeling very real. 

The gif here is quite sped up for dramatic effect.
